set.body: Execution mirror for canonical reframe4s epic bd-01KYNR748JZYEP3A5Q1H9ZB3AR. The reframe4s epic owns architecture and final acceptance; this epic owns ScalaFIM paths, compatibility, migration, and consumer evidence. Replace the private ScalaFIM NDArray and dense NeuroImage, NeuroVol, and NeuroVec representation stack with image4s Sampled values backed directly by Ravel. Preserve logical (i,j,k) and (i,j,k,t) access while translating legacy first-axis-fastest storage only at checked ingress boundaries. Redesign SparseNeuroVec as selected support or GridDomain plus compact rank-2 Ravel storage, not as another dense image or array hierarchy. Migrate masks, labels, components, I/O, serialization, workflows, and algorithms; then remove duplicate geometry, raw offsets, iteration, and kernels. Every compatibility adapter must be zero-copy or explicitly materializing and temporary. Exit only after the canonical matched semantics, allocation, performance, cross-platform, and downstream consumer gates pass and canonical gate bd-01KYNR86DV1M5CZFR0P3K7J4YN records the evidence.
